WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref AS site_code,
    si.healtheval AS health_status,
    AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT
    group_stats.*,
    AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS mean_group_avg
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  health_status,
  avg_ratio,
  scan_count,
  avg_ratio - mean_group_avg AS amount_above_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_group_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND avg_ratio > mean_group_avg
ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
